evals.prompt: Use the bundled Nanyan proposal workflow to turn the provided questionnaire Excel into the monthly Word report, preserving the approved template and validating every page.
evals.expected_output: A month-isolated DOCX, audit JSON, manifest, source snapshot, and page previews with all source rows and measures traceable.

evals.prompt: Process a questionnaire where one response contains four unrelated issues. Split them into independently actionable proposals and document any reused source row.
evals.expected_output: Independent proposals with allowed_reused_rows and measure_basis quotations for each issue.

evals.prompt: For every proposal, search the prior 12 months of Nanyan proposal history and distinguish verified proposal evidence from ordinary campus news or meetings.
evals.expected_output: One historical_search_log record per proposal; only verified and in-window evidence appears in Word supplements.
